answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the nadir graph. Re-attestations are stored in zephyr and orchard lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 864 impostors cost 1654 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
